# **About**

Want Minecraft to run smoothly without a top-of-the-line PC? Aeryon Optimized is your go-to modpack, built from scratch for pure speed. No junk, no fluff - just a carefully curated modpack to keep your game running smoothly. The star of the show? Sodium, which blows the standard Minecraft renderer out of the water, plus select optimization mods.
What does that give you? Huge FPS, smooth gameplay without freezes (even on crazy servers like Hypixel) and load times that won't make you want to grab a coffee while you wait. This pack is a real revolution, especially for older hardware or budget builds. We made it compact on purpose: only what really works, without unnecessary ballast and compatibility issues.
The numbers don't lie (see the FPS table below  -  tested on my not-so-new computer!), but the main thing is the feeling: everything flies, reacts instantly, and is just... cool. If your game is lagging or you want to squeeze out the maximum frames, Aeryon Optimized will change your Minecraft for the better. Try it  -  you won't regret it!

### **Fps Range**

- Vanilla | 1 - 127 FPS
- Aeryon Optimization | 324 - 478 FPS

Note: this result is tested under my low-end PC in Hypixel server.
